from engine.scorer import Scorer

results = [BenchmarkResult(question_id=i, question="q", expected="x", predicted="x", correct=b) for i, b in enumerate([1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0])]

import sys, pathlib

sys.path.insert(0, str(_p / "20-llm-eval-benchmark"))
from engine.scorer import Scorer
from benchmarks.base import BenchmarkResult
results = [BenchmarkResult(question_id=i, question="q", expected="x", predicted="x", correct=b) for i, b in enumerate([1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0])]
